title: Frozen DSR/PBO/CPCV protocol for strategy discovery v1
purpose: Correct performance significance for multiple testing and non-normal returns, estimate probability of backtest overfitting, and gate future candidates before OOS and existing-ladder validation.

methodology_references.citation: Bailey and Lopez de Prado (2014), The Deflated Sharpe Ratio
methodology_references.role: DSR corrects Sharpe inference for selection bias under multiple testing and non-normal returns.

methodology_references.citation: Lopez de Prado (2018), Advances in Financial Machine Learning
methodology_references.role: Reference methodology for purging, embargoing, CPCV, and backtest-overfitting controls.

methodology_references.citation: Arian, Norouzi Mobarekeh, and Seco (2024), Backtest Overfitting in the Machine Learning Era
methodology_references.role: Supplementary comparative evidence on CPCV and PBO; not a replacement for the primary methodology.

return_definition.unit: one timestamped strategy-equity return after costs
return_definition.annualization: annualization_factor is fixed per market/timeframe in the future batch manifest and is not tuned per candidate
return_definition.excess_return: strategy return minus the frozen cash/funding benchmark defined by the batch manifest
return_definition.missing_data: fail closed; do not forward-fill a decision field and do not silently drop an event that changes timing
return_definition.overlap_control: label horizon and maximum holding period are recorded; overlapping labels are purged in CPCV

trial_accounting.definition: N is the total number of distinct strategy trials exposed to selection before the selected candidate is reported.
count_units: every collected candidate that reaches a measured trial
every feature or rule variant tested
every execution, cost, or sizing variant tested when it can affect selection
failed, rejected, and non-surviving measured trials
not_counted_as_new_trial: a deterministic rerun with identical canonical rule hash, data manifest hash, and protocol versions
a report-only formatting rerun that cannot affect selection
trial_accounting.required_artifact: immutable trial ledger with trial_id, candidate_id, canonical_rule_hash, data_manifest_hash, protocol_id, metrics, status, and timestamp
trial_accounting.selection_cutoff: N is frozen at the selection event and cannot be reduced after observing results

dsr.name: Deflated Sharpe Ratio
dsr.interpretation: DSR is the probabilistic significance that the observed Sharpe exceeds the selection-adjusted benchmark Sharpe.

inputs.sr_observed: annualized Sharpe ratio of the selected candidate on the specified in-sample return series
inputs.sr_benchmark: pre-specified null or benchmark Sharpe; default 0.0 only when the batch manifest declares a zero-excess-return null
inputs.n_trials: N from the immutable trial ledger, including all measured alternatives exposed to selection
inputs.sr_std_null: pre-specified standard deviation of Sharpe estimates under the batch null/trial distribution
inputs.t_observations: number of timestamped return observations used in the Sharpe estimate
inputs.skewness: sample skewness of the candidate return series, computed before annualization
inputs.kurtosis: sample Pearson kurtosis of the candidate return series, not excess kurtosis

formula_steps: For N > 1, c_N = (1 - gamma) * Phi_inverse(1 - 1/N) + gamma * Phi_inverse(1 - 1/(N*e)).

edge_cases.n_trials_equal_1: sr_selection_benchmark = sr_benchmark; still apply the non-normal-return denominator.
edge_cases.denominator_non_positive: invalid; fail the gate and record numerical_error.
edge_cases.non_finite_input: invalid; fail the gate and record invalid_metric.
edge_cases.sr_std_null_missing: invalid; do not substitute an estimated value after selection.

gate.meaning: The candidate must have at least 95% probability, under the frozen DSR approximation, of exceeding the selection-adjusted benchmark. This is a research gate, not a claim of live profitability.

cpcv.name: Combinatorial Purged Cross-Validation
cpcv.purpose: Create multiple chronological train/test paths while preventing label leakage from overlapping observations and boundary information.

partition.selection_rule: all combinations of 2 test groups from 6 chronological groups
partition.group_assignment: contiguous chronological blocks with no random shuffling; each timestamp belongs to one group

purge_and_embargo.purge_rule: Remove every training observation whose label interval overlaps the test interval or whose information set reaches into the test interval.
purge_and_embargo.embargo_rule: After each test interval, embargo the next max_holding_period or label_horizon, whichever is longer, from training; the exact duration is recorded in the batch manifest.
purge_and_embargo.minimum_gap: At least one decision interval, with the larger of the label horizon and maximum holding period taking precedence.
purge_and_embargo.fit_isolation: All transforms, thresholds, normalizations, and parameter selections must be fit on the training portion only for each split.

per_split_procedure: Construct the chronological train/test split from the frozen group assignment.
Apply purge and embargo using the candidate's declared label horizon and maximum holding period.
Evaluate the complete pre-declared candidate set on the training data with no post-hoc rule changes.
Select the in-sample winner by the pre-declared training objective; record all training ranks and metrics.
Evaluate the selected winner on the untouched test interval; record its test metric and its rank among all candidate configurations evaluated on that test interval.
Assign the split result to a CPCV path so each timestamp is represented in an OOS path exactly once.

pbo.name: Probability of Backtest Overfitting
calculation: For each CPCV path, let omega be the percentile rank of the training-selected candidate's test performance among all candidate configurations on that path, with ties assigned the mid-rank.
Compute lambda = log(omega / (1 - omega)); omega must be strictly between 0 and 1 after deterministic tie handling.
pbo.interpretation: PBO is the fraction of CPCV paths where the configuration selected in training performs below the median of the candidate set out of sample.

gate.meaning: The candidate must not fail the below-median OOS-rank test on more than 10% of frozen CPCV paths.

pre_backtest_invariants: The source registry, rejection taxonomy, normalization schema, return definition, trial ledger, DSR parameters, CPCV partition, purge/embargo rules, and gates are committed before the first measured trial.
No candidate may be modified after seeing its in-sample result without creating a new trial_id and counting it in N.
The in-sample objective, ranking direction, tie handling, and candidate universe are declared before CPCV execution.
All timestamps, data manifests, feature versions, and code versions are immutable inputs to the trial identity.
A DSR or PBO pass authorizes only the next research gate; it does not authorize trading or deployment.
required_outputs_per_batch: DSR inputs, formula components, DSR value, and gate result
CPCV partition, purge and embargo counts, path metrics, lambda values, PBO, and gate result
registry update with protocol_id and protocol hash
